entries.subject: Radius, mass and temperature
entries.finding: Radius 1.09414 solar radii from Lafarga et al. 2026, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of TOI-1722 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026MNRAS.548ag512L/abstract). Mass 1.076 (1.036 to 1.116) from Gaia DR3 FLAME (Creevey et al. 2023, A&A 674, A26; astrophysical_parameters of the same source). entries.subject: Limb darkening
entries.finding: The disc is dimmed toward the limb by the quadratic law Claret & Bloemen (2011), A&A 529, A75 compute from ATLAS model atmospheres for the Johnson V band at 5,999.55 K and log g 4.39 (u1 0.414, u2 0.286): a model, because no fit of this star's limb is used.
